messages:
noah (SecEng): FYI: external pentest vendor confirmed for next Tue. We need a short runbook for scoped RBAC changes, KMS delegation, and audit export. Who can join a 30m sync later today?

tasha (Infra): I can in the afternoon. We should pre-decide which service accounts are in-scope so we can template the role grants.

devops-bot: New intake created: PT-2024-09 by noah. Auto-assigned: noah, tasha, jamie. Link: https://go/internal/pt/PT-2024-09 (private).

ev an (SRE): Afternoon works. Quick ask: do assessors need kms:Decrypt or just envelope unwrap? We prefer a decrypt-proxy to avoid exposing keys.

jamie (Platform): Suggest a limited grant: kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + kms:Decrypt on a single alias, with condition aws:SourceIp for vendor network and a timebound Expiration tag. Example policy snippet to share in sync.

noah (SecEng): Good. Also: audit baseline export — CloudTrail + object-level S3 logs + app-level request logs. We'll snapshot pre-test and collect provenance. Tasha, can infra prepare the S3 prefix and presigned upload for vendor artifacts?

tasha (Infra): Yep. I'll create s3://redwood-pt-archive/2024-09-pt-2024-09/ and attach a write-only presigned path for vendor evidence. We'll enable bucket access logging and lock down KMS key used to encrypt objects.

ejan (SRE): Small note: ensure the SIEM team has a drop-in for that prefix so they can index quickly. Also, we'll capture ephemeral bastion session recordings if console access is requested.

noah (SecEng): Decision: prefer API-only for assessment. If they request console, require a supervised screen-share session and a temporary console role that is session-recorded. No unattended console grants.

jamie (Platform): For RBAC we should use short-lived OIDC bound roles. I'll draft a role template: 1h TTL, scoping to specific service resources (SQS, RDS read-only), and deny for iam:CreateRole. Will post draft asap.

tasha (Infra): KMS change plan: create a dedicated alias alias/pt-2024-09, add key policy allowing the ephemeral role, and enable AWS CloudTrail KMS event logging for that alias. We'll rotate the key on retest completion.

noah (SecEng): Remediation flow: tracker (spreadsheet) + canonical ticket template for each vuln with severity, owner, ETA, mitigation steps, and evidence field. Propose retest windows: +7 days and +21 days after fix merge. Arbitrate earlier if high severity.

ev an (SRE): I'll prep pre-test log snapshots (app, infra, and audit) and a short commands log to reproduce state. Also will hand off access patterns to sec for triage.

jamie (Platform): Flag: if vendor requests expanded KMS scope and we can't avoid it, fallback = host-side decrypt proxy under our control that logs requests and enforces ACLs. We used that for last year's external test.

noah (SecEng): Action items (today): jamie -> role template, tasha -> S3 prefix + bucket policy + KMS alias, evan -> log snapshots, noah -> create tracker + ticket templates. Meet at 16:00 PT in #sec-triage (30m).

tasha (Infra): Acknowledged. I'll include the presigned upload example and the bucket policy snippet in the tracker.

ev an (SRE): On it. I'll also test the SIEM ingestion path and post the confirmation.

noah (SecEng): Thanks team. If anything blocks access modelling, ping sec-eng-oncall. We'll keep the retest cadence flexible but try to hit the +7 slot for critical fixes. :rocket:
